retained_reason: The unfolded mechanism orders bids by decreasing value/|desired|, breaks ties consistently by a fixed bidder order, and greedily accepts nonconflicting bundles. A winner pays the unit price of the first later bid rejected solely because of that winner, multiplied by the winner's bundle size; if no such bid exists, or the bidder loses, payment is 0. Utility is the true single-minded valuation minus payment. Truthfulness permits changes to both value and desired and quantifies arbitrary other reports. This matches the mechanism and truthfulness claim in Section 10; nonempty bundles and nonnegative values define the selected single-minded domain. Moving the before/after interfaces does not change these definitions.
